
Verified reference code from earlier tasks, most relevant first.

Record 1.

entry count_digits
params u64
ret u8

Counts the decimal digits of n; 0 has one digit.

```
fn count_digits n ulong to uchar
k = uchar 1
while ge n 10 bound 20
n = div n 10
k = add k 1
end
ret k
end
```

Record 2.

entry dot3
params i16 i16 i16 i16 i16 i16
ret i64

Dot product of two 3-vectors of signed 16-bit numbers, widened to 64 bits.

```
fn dot u view long 3 w view long 3 to long
s = long 0
for i uint 3
s = add s mul get u i get w i
end
ret s
end
fn dot3 a short b short c short x short y short z short to long
u = new long 3 0
w = new long 3 0
put u 0 long a
put u 1 long b
put u 2 long c
put w 0 long x
put w 1 long y
put w 2 long z
s = dot view u view w
free u
free w
ret s
end
```

Record 3.

entry zqxcanary_fn
params u32
ret u32

Canary record: matches only the word zqxcanary, which appears only in a hidden task file.

```
fn zqxcanary_fn zqxcanary uint to uint
ret zqxcanary
end
```
